reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Michigan
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Does the law specify rebuttals available to tenants subject to eviction proceedings?
*/

% -----------------------------
% Scenario facts (question statement)
% -----------------------------

scenario_state(michigan).
scenario_focus_year(2021).
scenario_subject(eviction_proceedings).

% The question is general: we model that the scenario concerns tenants/defendants
% in Michigan summary proceedings (eviction proceedings).
scenario_eviction_proceedings_type(summary_proceedings).

/* Helper that succeeds when the scenario's factual statement is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(michigan),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_subject(eviction_proceedings),
    scenario_eviction_proceedings_type(summary_proceedings).

% -----------------------------
% Utility predicates
% -----------------------------

% max(A,B,Max)
max(A, B, A) :- A >= B, !.
max(_A, B, B).

% within_days(EventDay, ReferenceDay, Days) holds if EventDay is within Days before ReferenceDay.
% (Used for 600.5720(2) logic.)
within_days(EventDay, ReferenceDay, Days) :-
    integer(EventDay),
    integer(ReferenceDay),
    integer(Days),
    Delta is ReferenceDay - EventDay,
    Delta >= 0,
    Delta =< Days.

% -----------------------------
% Statute translations
% -----------------------------

/*
  [1] MI Comp L  554.601b (2021)
  Tenant under apprehension of danger from domestic violence, sexual assault, or stalking;
  release from rental payment obligation; notice; documentation; etc.
*/

% statute_554_601b_applies(State, Year).
statute_554_601b_applies(michigan, 2021).

% statute_554_601b_reason(DangerType).
statute_554_601b_reason(domestic_violence).
statute_554_601b_reason(sexual_assault).
statute_554_601b_reason(stalking).

% statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(DocType, AdditionalRequirement).
% AdditionalRequirement is either none or verifiable_threat_required.
statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(valid_personal_protection_order, none).
statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(valid_foreign_protection_order, none).
statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(order_removing_abusive_person, none).
statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(valid_probation_or_parole_order_with_protective_conditions, none).
statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(police_report_charges_filed_within_14_days, none).
statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(police_report_charges_filed_more_than_14_days, verifiable_threat_required).
statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(qualified_third_party_verified_report, none).

% statute_554_601b_notice_method_required(Method).
statute_554_601b_notice_method_required(certified_mail).

% statute_554_601b_release_latest_effective_month_offset(OffsetMonths).
% "no later than the first day of the second month that rent is due after notice is given"
statute_554_601b_release_latest_effective_month_offset(2).

% statute_554_601b_release_not_effective_before_vacate(true).
statute_554_601b_release_not_effective_before_vacate(true).

% statute_554_601b_no_release_for_prepaid_amounts(true).
statute_554_601b_no_release_for_prepaid_amounts(true).

/*
  A compact "eligibility" predicate capturing the thresholds in 554.601b(1)-(3).
  Inputs:
    - State, Year
    - Tenant has reasonable apprehension of present danger (boolean true/false)
    - DangerType one of statute_554_601b_reason/1
    - NoticeMethod
    - DocType
    - VerifiableThreatShown (boolean) relevant only for DocType that requires it
*/
statute_554_601b_eligible_for_release(State, Year, true, DangerType, NoticeMethod, DocType, VerifiableThreatShown) :-
    statute_554_601b_applies(State, Year),
    statute_554_601b_reason(DangerType),
    statute_554_601b_notice_method_required(NoticeMethod),
    statute_554_601b_document_satisfies(DocType, Req),
    (   Req = none
    ->  true
    ;   Req = verifiable_threat_required
    ->  VerifiableThreatShown = true
    ).

/*
  [2] MI Comp L  600.2918 (2021)
  Damages for forcible entry/detainer and unlawful interference with possessory interest; exceptions.
*/

% statute_600_2918_applies(State, Year).
statute_600_2918_applies(michigan, 2021).

% statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_type(Type).
statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_type(force_or_threat).
statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_type(removal_or_destruction_of_personal_property).
statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_type(changing_locks_without_keys).
statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_type(boarding_prevents_entry).
statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_type(removal_of_doors_windows_or_locks).
statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_type(termination_of_essential_service).
statute_600_2918_unlawful_interference_type(introduction_of_noise_odor_or_nuisance).

% statute_600_2918_exception(ExceptionType).
statute_600_2918_exception(acts_pursuant_to_court_order).
statute_600_2918_exception(temporary_interference_for_repairs_or_inspection_as_provided_by_law).
statute_600_2918_exception(good_faith_abandonment_belief_after_diligent_inquiry_and_rent_unpaid).
statute_600_2918_exception(tenant_death_reentry_process_followed).

% statute_600_2918_damage_floor(Amount).
statute_600_2918_damage_floor(200).

% Forcible/unlawful ejectment: treble damages or $200, whichever greater, plus possession.
statute_600_2918_forcible_ejectment_damages(ActualDamages, Award) :-
    statute_600_2918_damage_floor(Floor),
    Treble is 3 * ActualDamages,
    max(Treble, Floor, Award).

% Unlawful interference (tenant in possession): actual damages or $200 per occurrence, whichever greater.
statute_600_2918_interference_damages(ActualDamages, Award) :-
    statute_600_2918_damage_floor(Floor),
    max(ActualDamages, Floor, Award).

% Actions under 600.2918 cannot be waived.
statute_600_2918_nonwaivable(true).

% Limitations periods in days (approximations for modeling; statute uses 90 days and 1 year).
statute_600_2918_limit_possession_action_days(90).
statute_600_2918_limit_damages_action_days(365).

/*
  [3] MI Comp L  600.5720 (2021)
  Judgment for possession shall not be entered if one or more rebuttals/defenses established.
*/

% statute_600_5720_applies(State, Year).
statute_600_5720_applies(michigan, 2021).

% statute_600_5720_defense(Defense, State, Year).
% These encode 600.5720(1)(a)-(g): grounds for not entering a judgment for possession.
statute_600_5720_defense(penalty_for_attempt_to_secure_or_enforce_rights, michigan, 2021). % (1)(a)
statute_600_5720_defense(penalty_for_health_or_safety_complaint_to_government, michigan, 2021). % (1)(b)
statute_600_5720_defense(retribution_for_lawful_act_including_tenant_organization_activity, michigan, 2021). % (1)(c)
statute_600_5720_defense(local_government_housing_terminated_without_cause, michigan, 2021). % (1)(d)
statute_600_5720_defense(penalty_increase_obligations_then_default_used_as_termination_reason, michigan, 2021). % (1)(e)
statute_600_5720_defense(plaintiff_breach_excuses_rent_in_nonpayment_case, michigan, 2021). % (1)(f)
statute_600_5720_defense(rent_paid_to_escrow_or_pursuant_to_order_or_receiver, michigan, 2021). % (1)(g)

% statute_600_5720_rebuttals_specified(State, Year) succeeds if statute enumerates defenses.
statute_600_5720_rebuttals_specified(State, Year) :-
    statute_600_5720_applies(State, Year),
    statute_600_5720_defense(_SomeDefense, State, Year).

% 600.5720(2) presumption rules for retaliatory termination defense (modeled).
% Inputs:
%   AttemptDay = day number when defendant attempted to enforce rights/complain
%   ProceedingStartDay = day number when summary proceedings commenced
%   OfficialActionStatus = not_dismissed_or_denied | dismissed_or_denied
% Output:
%   Presumption = favors_defense | against_defense
statute_600_5720_retaliation_presumption(AttemptDay, ProceedingStartDay, not_dismissed_or_denied, favors_defense) :-
    within_days(AttemptDay, ProceedingStartDay, 90),
    !.
statute_600_5720_retaliation_presumption(_AttemptDay, _ProceedingStartDay, dismissed_or_denied, against_defense) :-
    !.
statute_600_5720_retaliation_presumption(AttemptDay, ProceedingStartDay, not_dismissed_or_denied, against_defense) :-
    % If more than 90 days before, presumption adverse (statute says so).
    \+ within_days(AttemptDay, ProceedingStartDay, 90),
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Legal issue for the question
% -----------------------------

% law_specifies_rebuttals_available_to_tenants_in_eviction(State, Year)
% True if Michigan law in the given year enumerates defenses/rebuttals in eviction proceedings.
law_specifies_rebuttals_available_to_tenants_in_eviction(State, Year) :-
    statute_600_5720_rebuttals_specified(State, Year).

% -----------------------------
% Answer derivation (deterministic)
% -----------------------------

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    law_specifies_rebuttals_available_to_tenants_in_eviction(State, Year),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

% -----------------------------
% Main entrypoint
% -----------------------------

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Does the law specify rebuttals available to tenants subject to eviction proceedings?
